title: Aisha Finally Checked Where $380 Went

scenes.say: $380 a month on food delivery. Aisha finally checked her statement.
12 orders, about $32 each. The food itself was only about $20.
The other $12 per order? Fees, tips and higher menu prices.
Over a year, that's about $1,700 that never touches the food.
So she set one rule: 4 deliveries a month, and cook 8 more nights.
4 orders is about $128. Eight home meals, about $48.
She keeps about $200 a month. That's roughly $2,400 a year.
How many deliveries did you order last month? Subscribe so you don't make this mistake on your next paycheck, because 12 deliveries means $380 gone.
